<h1>Lucas Henriksson</h1>

I am a third-year PhD student at the [Stockholm School of Economics](https://www.hhs.se/). I am also an affiliated researcher at the [Research Group for Socioeconomic Studies of Technology](https://soetech.org/) at Lund University.

My research interests lie in the intersection of labor and public economics, with a particular focus on social security systems, unemployment and unions. I have also done policy work on taxation, with a focus on local and regional governments.
